title: Snapshot and restoration
requirements: 11.02. The snapshot contains a tuple copy of retained entries.
11.03. The snapshot stores the current next sequence.
11.04. Later journal mutations cannot change the snapshot's entries tuple.
11.07. `restore()` replaces the current next sequence with `snapshot.nextSequence`.
11.08. `restore()` does not recalculate or reset the snapshot's next sequence.
11.09. A bounded journal rejects a snapshot containing more entries than `maxEntries`.
11.10. A rejected restoration does not partially alter journal state.
11.11. A valid restoration preserves gaps and non-1 starting sequences.
11.12. Appending after restoration uses the restored `nextSequence`.
